meta.description:
A ceremonial observatory built around an imagined celestial impact, with rooms arranged as an asymmetric cross of processional halls, instrument chambers, and a sunken crater
    shrine. Its spatial sequence expands from a compressed entrance into a tall central meridian before branching toward the sky, the earth, and a luminous eastern terminus.

rooms.name: The Eclipse Threshold
rooms.style: A compressed entrance chamber resembling the interior of an astronomical shutter, furnished with overlapping dark superquadric discs, squat benches, and narrow bronze guide rails. Surfaces are matte charcoal stone with sparse copper details.
